provider.docs:
**string**: The name of the provider node.

*See also: [Packet Transport Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/packet_transport#configuration-variables)*

remote_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the original binary sensor in the provider device. If not specified defaults to the ID configured with `id:`.

*See also: [Packet Transport Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/packet_transport#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [Packet Transport Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/packet_transport#configuration-variables)*

name.docs:
**string**: The name of the binary sensor.

*See also: [Packet Transport Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/packet_transport#configuration-variables)*

internal.docs:
**boolean**: Whether the sensor should be exposed via API (e.g. to Home Assistant.) Defaults to `true` if name is not set, required if name is provided.

*See also: [Packet Transport Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/packet_transport#configuration-variables)*
